title: Neutral substitution rate equals the mutation rate

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Neutral substitution rate equals the mutation rate

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: For neutral mutations the long-run rate of molecular substitution equals the mutation rate per generation, independent of population size, which yields a molecular clock.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Evolutionary Rate at the Molecular Level

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Evolutionary Rate at the Molecular Level (1968)

fields.label: Source as written
fields.value: Motoo Kimura (1968) Evolutionary Rate at the Molecular Level

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: strictly neutral mutations, mutation rate constant per generation, steady state

fields.label: Formal status in the nanopub
fields.value: an exact consequence of the neutral fixation probability. Variation in generation time and weak selection on nearly neutral sites cause departures from strict clock-like rates.

fields.label: Proposed test
fields.value: Compare the substitution rate at putatively neutral sites (synonymous sites, pseudogenes) across lineages with independently measured per-generation mutation rates from pedigree sequencing.
